“Yes. That townscape with the moon... Could I have it?”

ただ月をあなたからもらうだけですよ」

“There's no particular reason. I'm just accepting the moon from you.”

“It's a good painting...”

Naoya
“You think so? It's a failure.”

「そうかも……でもいい絵ですよ……」

“Maybe... But it's a good painting...”

Naoya
“What's that supposed to mean...?”

Naoya

“Even when it comes to painting... there are things you don't understand.”

ja.text: 夏休みの最後の日、あそこからの風景が綺麗だったので、写真に収めたものだ。

en.text: I had photographed it on the last day of summer vacation because the view was beautiful.

ja.text: 写真では新月だったが、なんとなく満月に変えたんだよな……。

en.text: The photograph had been taken under a new moon, but I'd changed it to a full moon for no particular reason...

ja.text: 満月……そういえば、吹と俺が勝負した夜も満月だったっけな……。

en.text: I thought he'd kept painting until the very last moment, too.
